invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$2200（入场价+0.86%，基于当前价格和ATR调整以保护利润），或Qlib评分跌出前三，或融资费率Z-score超过100%（多头过度拥挤）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $2200 (entry +0.86%, adjusted based on current price and ATR to protect profits), or Qlib score falls out of top 3, or funding Z-score exceeds 100% (overly crowded longs).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.08942（入场价-4.5%，基于ATR调整），或Qlib评分跌出前三，或融资费率Z-score超过100%（多头过度拥挤），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.08942 (entry -4.5%, adjusted based on ATR), or Qlib score falls out of top 3, or funding Z-score exceeds 100% (overly crowded longs), or daily trend turns bearish (price below SMA50).
